outcomes.text: Translate about six sentences from a prescribed Ramayana or Mahabharata story from Sanskrit into English.
Locate and pull out information from a passage and explain the context it comes from.
Use standard Devanagari and transliterated Sanskrit scripts.
Transliterate six to eight adapted unseen Sanskrit sentences.
Answer three comprehension questions, set in Sanskrit, on an unseen Sanskrit passage.
Daśaratha is cursed (18 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Daśaratha's sons (12 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Mithilā (13 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Śiva's bow (15 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Rāma returns to Ayodhyā (12 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Who will be king? (11 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
The Pāṇḍavas' house is burned down (10 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Kīcaka fails to woo Draupadī (10 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Abhimanyu's battle plan (10 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Duryodhana is slain (10 sentences): read, translate and answer comprehension questions.

units.title: Paper 2: Translation, Set Texts and Panini Grammar

outcomes.text: Translate six lines of adapted unseen Sanskrit prose into English, with unfamiliar words glossed.
Translate the set verses 2.38, 2.45, 2.47, 3.9 and 4.8.
Translate the set verses 6.19, 6.35, 7.4, 7.5, 9.27, 12.13 and 18.73.
The crows and the serpent: read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
The lion, the rabbit and the well: read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
The sage and the mouse: read, translate and answer comprehension questions.
Decline asmad and yuṣmad in all three numbers.
Decline tat in all three genders and numbers.
Decline bālaka and muni in all three numbers.
Decline bālikā and mati in all three numbers.
Decline phala in all three numbers.
Conjugate bhū, gam, as, dṛś, kṛ, pib, gai, vad and khel in the present, future and past (imperfect) in three persons and numbers.
Explain the principal uses of the cases (English may be used).
Define the rules of svara sandhi (vowel joining) with examples.
List the Māheśvara sūtras and say which sūtra a given letter belongs to.
Explain the Uccāraṇa sūtras.
